title: Vague token
description: JSON Schema for a vague-token record — a token specialized by a watchlist trigger that classified its surface as a stretch-indicator. Extends the token schema with trigger-reason and exempt-cues.

surface.description: The matched bytes as they appeared in the source.

position.description: Where in the source the token appeared.

source.description: The path or origin of the source the token was found in.

triggerReason.description: The free-text reason recorded on the watchlist entry that fired the match.

exemptCues.description: Words or phrases whose presence in the surrounding window suppresses the flag because they indicate the token is being used precisely.

triggerKind.description: Whether the match was against a literal token surface (literal-token) or against a regex hedge-pattern (hedge-pattern).
